Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and monocytosis. Oxygen saturation is significantly reduced (88.1%), suggesting hypoxemia. Red cell distribution width is elevated, indicating anisocytosis. Electrolytes, renal, and liver function are within normal limits except for low AST. Findings may indicate chronic disease, infection, or bone marrow dysfunction; clinical correlation is recommended.
